scope: Server-side dry-run admission of hostPID, hostIPC, and hostNetwork independently under namespace-enforced, Kubernetes-v1.36-pinned Pod Security Admission Baseline and Restricted. A separate ValidatingAdmissionPolicy demonstrates one exact, non-persisted hostNetwork-only synthetic exception behind a test-specific, revocable namespace RBAC grant. The case verifies withdrawal and ordinary Restricted admission afterward. One ordinary isolated Pod is run to Ready. No host-namespace Pod is created or run; host state and sensitive endpoints are never queried.
